model: Inherited parent model/configuration in four fresh collaboration agents; no model overrides. Exact backend identifier and reasoning level not exposed in the execution record.
sampling: One batch per condition; eight sequential requests share that agent context. Other batches, expected answers and proposed changes withheld.
capabilities: Local filesystem, Python and Node only; no network, browser, host database/sampling/download APIs, publishing, installs or global fonts.
grading: Lead semantic review against frozen criteria; reviewer knew condition names. Not a blind or statistical evaluation.
